description:
This page tracks changes related to VIPs and VIP Prefix Allocations and Reservations in NRP.

The Allocations property on a PublicIP/PublicIPPrefix use new APIs which go directly to the downstream microservice VipManager vs the existing method of SviManager-> VipManager.

props.title: Put/Delete Public IP +VIP Related QOS Errors

children.header:
This includes: 
* Standard Public IPs allocated via VipManager as of nrp 187.
* Basic Dynamic Ips- allocated via VipManager through tenant pipeline 
* Basic Static Ips- reserved with PutPublicIpAddressOperation via SviManager
children.helpText: Please note there are several edge cases for each type of public ip

children.header: If VIP was initially allocated through VipManager, will be released offline. Else SviManager
Allocated VIPs are released async, and Reserved VIPS are sync
VIP Transfer API updates an Allocation to a Reservation. Some resources have a dependency on SVI (ie) ELB or Cx converting a public ip from Basic Dynamic to Basic Static.
